<!-- pr-reviewer: efc219647bf1040e41b79bacf03b3bc3e13d8350 -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change affects wire gouge checks and the post refusal. The code review found no other blocker.

The PR trial-merges cleanly with upstream/main `a35c9cb8197f484fca0f8311610bdc8594111a0f`. All tests below ran locally on that trial merge. No GitHub runner was used.

**Results**

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. All 627 steps completed in 37.1 minutes. The 626 test targets passed 4,383 tests; 47 tests were ignored.
- The gate built the app test binaries and ran the sim library: 224 tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- Heavy gate: dry run only. It selects 236 steps for the app and motion lanes, including the release build. The heavy and light lanes were not run within this review's time budget. This is not a pass.

The wire suites all passed:

| App suite | Passed |
|---|---:|
| wire_4axis | 8 |
| wire_burnout | 3 |
| wire_contour | 8 |
| wire_fans | 2 |
| wire_post | 12 |
| wire_readers | 7 |
| wire_stamp | 7 |
| wire_tabs | 4 |
| wire_taper | 10 |
| wire_taper_angle | 5 |
| wire_taper_chord | 3 |
| wire_tool | 5 |
| wire_verify | 3 |
| wire_verify_tol | 2 |

**Extra suites run**

No fixture directory or importer code changed. Neither extra selection rule requires another suite. I also ran `cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-app --test wire_taper_chord` for each mutation and each restoration.

**Mutations repeated independently**

- Set the constant-taper tolerance to zero: RED. The true-angle test and the undercut test failed. Restored: GREEN, all 3 tests passed.
- Disable the undercut branch: RED. The undercut test failed because the program posted. Restored: GREEN, all 3 tests passed.

The source was restored after each mutation. `git diff --exit-code` passed after the checks. No golden changed. There were no moved G-code or CL goldens to inspect.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/sim/src/verify/wire/mod.rs:306`: Required heavy test results are missing. Upstream main's **Heavy lanes at review** rule requires the reached heavy tests to pass before the PR is ready. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Add the lane results to the PR body. The dry run reaches the app and motion lanes; the body reports neither lane. Complete the light lane check at review time as required by **The light lane**.

The body states the remaining limits: no real STEP die, no recorded coarse-chord test, and no real EDM control. No UI file changed, so before/after screenshots are not required.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
